cues.en: And the right part equals.
cues.zh: 再右半部等於多少。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this one was w minus one times one minus W.
cues.zh: 這裡是 (w-1) 乘 (1-w)。

cues.en: It's a funny set of expressions there.
cues.zh: 很有趣的一組式子。

cues.en: So then the denominator was this was probably the most difficult part of this to get, right?
cues.zh: 分母可能是這裡最難寫對的部分。

cues.en: So minus W squared times Z minus W squared plus two times W times Z plus two times W minus Z minus one.
cues.zh: 負 w 平方乘 z，減 w 平方，加 2 乘 w 乘 z，加 2 乘 w，減 z，再減 1。

cues.en: Quite a mouthful.
cues.zh: 真拗口。

cues.en: Now if you're thinking that I have like some amazing memory for these kinds of things, I don't.
cues.zh: 如果以為我記這些東西的記憶力很驚人，其實沒有。

cues.en: I'm actually cross referencing this with my other monitor.
cues.zh: 我是在另一個螢幕上對照。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So anyway, the right part is right numerator divided by right denominator.
cues.zh: 總之，右半部就是右分子除以右分母。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then the last thing I'm going to simplify is actually creating a variable called solution.
cues.zh: 最後要做的簡化，是建立叫 solution 的變數。

cues.en: And that's just the left part times the right part.
cues.zh: 就是左半部乘右半部。

cues.en: Now, again, I'd like to highlight that this is seven lines of code, and technically you could put all of this stuff into one really, really, really long line of code.
cues.zh: 再強調，這有七行程式，技術上可以把全部東西放進一行非常非常長的程式。

cues.en: However, I think you agree that this is more readable and less likely to produce errors.
cues.zh: 但相信你同意，這樣更好讀，也比較不容易出錯。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's print the solution, huh?
cues.zh: 印出 solution，嗯？

cues.en: And that's pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 很有趣。

cues.en: The result happens to be just one.
cues.zh: 結果剛好是 1。

cues.en: I mean, this is this is technically a complex number, but the imaginary part is zero.
cues.zh: 技術上是複數，但虛部為 0。

cues.en: So really, all of this stuff just worked out to one that is pretty funny.
cues.zh: 所以這全部算完其實就是 1，很有意思。

cues.en: And what I encourage you to do is change around some of these numbers and see whether this solution changes as these numbers change.
cues.zh: 鼓勵你改改這些數字，看看它們改變時，這個解會不會改變。

cues.en: So in this video, you learned about division with complex numbers and simplifying complex division using the conjugate trick.
cues.zh: 這段學了複數除法，以及利用共軛技巧化簡複數除法。

cues.en: And I discussed two different ways of breaking up long lines of code into multiple lines.
cues.zh: 也談了把長程式拆成多行的兩種方式。

cues.en: So one way was just literally moving parts of a line of code underneath.
cues.zh: 一種就是直接把同一行的某些部分移到下面。

cues.en: And a second way is using separate variables for different parts of the equation and then combining them later on.
cues.zh: 另一種是替方程式不同部分使用獨立變數，再把它們組合起來。

cues.en: Now, in the past, several videos I've been talking about complex numbers from a purely algebraic perspective,
cues.zh: 最近幾段一直從純代數角度討論複數，

cues.en: but it turns out that complex numbers also have a really interesting geometry associated with them, and that is the main topic of the next video.
cues.zh: 但複數其實也有很有趣的幾何意義，這就是下一段的主題。
